lobbyIn: Everyone goes back to the lobby in {seconds} s

not_found.title: This room is gone
not_found.body: It closed, or the code is wrong. Check the code or create a new room.

room_full.title: This room is full
room_full.body: Every seat is taken. Ask for another room or create yours.

already_started.title: This match already started
already_started.body: You can join the next one in this room, or create your own.

kicked.title: The host removed you from the room
kicked.body: You can come back in 2 minutes. Meanwhile, join another room or make your own.

banned.title: The host banned you from this room
banned.body: You can't come back here. Join another room or make your own.

moved.title: You're in another room now
moved.body: You can be in only one room at a time, and you joined {room}.

vote.title: Vote for the theme
vote.subtitle: The most voted theme wins. A tie goes to the wheel.

vote.change: tap another theme to change your vote, or yours again to take it back
vote.tie: Spinning the wheel between the tied themes…
